opportunities.title: Protect paid game and coaching authority
opportunities.summary: Remove valuable computation from public artifacts and authorize every protected service operation.
opportunities.diagnosis: The local prototype executes engine/coach and holds full state in the player-controlled browser.

evidence.claim: Existing React, TypeScript and Vite dependencies.
UI imports and invokes the engine and coach locally.
GameState includes full hands and deterministic seeded dealing.

desiredInvariants: Public demo cannot generate new games/advice.
Every protected operation validates identity, ownership and its applicable access policy.
Quota and accepted game records commit atomically.
Revoked work cannot publish; legitimate saved-result recovery remains available to its owner.
Hidden holdings are excluded from public observations.
